name: Ohneis
tagline: remotion-ads' Ohneis beat: dark minimal, lowercase Inter with one Instrument Serif keyword, hard cuts, slow Ken Burns.

motion.direction: Ohneis. Moody and minimal: everything lowercase, Inter 400 for the sentence and ONE Instrument Serif italic keyword 15 % larger; charcoal stage, bone `iv` text, muted `ter`. Hard cuts only, 0.5–2 s per beat, entries 4 frames (fade + scale 0.92 → 1); photos (`imageCard`, `bleedPlate`) carry all the colour, with a slow Ken Burns 1.0 → 1.03 alternating direction; a padded frame with 8 % border for the hero image. Rhythm: text → photo → text → photo, never three of the same frame type in a row, no crossfades, no stamps.
